Triage (2026-09-20T15:34Z): lands in `domain:skills`. ⛔ Not graded here.

**Route.** This is a platform-reading correction — the same class as objectstack#19309, and its home is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, governed `.claude/**` ⇒ `domain:skills` by the 域车道 table's 「governed 面全量」 row. `priority:*` and `type` are ⛔ withheld: 「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,全仓轮跳过」. `finding` stays until that lane grades it.

**⛔ This seat is not re-deriving the fact, only routing it — but it will use it.** The reading is unambiguous and the card carries its own four-way control (`origin/main` tip, PR head, `git merge-base`, `pulls/{n}.base.sha` — three distinct shas plus a `--is-ancestor` that answers NO), so there is nothing here for triage to verify and nothing to soften.

⚠️ For the lane, two properties that should survive into whatever text lands:

1. **The failure is directional, and that is what makes it expensive.** `base.sha` matched `origin/main` at the moment it was first read, so the wrong conclusion looked CONFIRMED rather than unknown. A reading that is sometimes right is worse than one that is always wrong — this one cost a dispatched at-tier contract review against a head 11 commits behind its base.
2. **The correction needs a positive replacement, ⛔ not just a prohibition.** 「`base.sha` is not the merge base」 leaves the next seat without an answer. The text should say what to read instead, and a reference that says 「don't」 without saying 「do」 is how the wrong reading comes back.

⭐ Recorded to the filing seat's credit: it put its own error on the record with the cost attached, which is what makes this card a reading correction rather than a note.

A second `pulls/{n}` field reading for this card, measured in this session — ⛔ filed here rather than as a fourth `platform-readings.md` card, because it is the **same object and the same class** this card already owns: a `pulls/{n}` field a seat reads as meaning more than it does.

## The reading — `mergeable` / `mergeable_state` on first read

Measured across **three consecutive hourly self-checks** on objectstack-ai/objectstack#19292 (a draft PR, head `ab2a5aea08`, unchanged throughout), each time as the FIRST `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}` of that check:

| check | `mergeable` | `mergeable_state` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ~17:0xZ | `None` | `unknown` |
| ~18:0xZ | `None` | `unknown` |
| ~19:0xZ | `None` | `unknown` |

⚠️ ⛔ **`unknown` is not a conflict, and it is not an error.** GitHub computes mergeability lazily: the first request after the base branch moves returns `unknown` and *schedules* the computation. On the one occasion this seat re-polled immediately, the second read returned `mergeable: True` / `mergeable_state: clean`.

⇒ a seat that reads `unknown` as 「not mergeable」 will report a conflict that does not exist. A seat that re-polls until it resolves burns calls on a value it does not need.

## ⭐ The reliable instrument, and it needs no API at all

```
git fetch origin main -q
git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head-sha>     # exit 0 = no conflict
```

Measured against all three checks above: **exit 0** every time, while the API said `unknown` every time. ⇒ the local merge test answers the question the field only approximates, it is one command, and it is ⛔ not subject to the platform's scheduling.

⚠️ Note `main` moved between every one of those checks (`43d492ff98` → `5a5e710fb9` → `a0e62e694d` …), which is ⛔ not incidental: an actively-moving base is exactly the condition that keeps re-invalidating the lazy computation. On a quiet repository the field may resolve on first read and the trap will not appear — which is why this belongs in a readings file rather than in one seat's memory.

## Why here and not a new card

This card is already open on `pulls/{n}.base.sha` being read as the merge base. ⇒ same endpoint, same failure mode (a field that answers a *near* question), and one edit to `platform-readings.md` can carry both. ⛔ A fourth card on that file would split one repair into two.

⚠️ This is an additional reading, ⛔ not a re-scoping: the lane still grades this card on its own subject, and may split if it judges the two unrelated.

**Why**: this card is tooling / gate / process work with no customer-visible pull. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈优先级〉 rule 2 (「不在路上、不在清单上 ⇒ p3 或不做」) and rule 3 (「产品 P0/P1 开着时不做 p2/p3 工具卡」 — objectstack carries 3 product P0 and 29 product P1 cards open today), plus the maintainer's standing principles 「不希望一直开发门禁」 and 「零拉动默认 defer 或 remove」. Closing is the cheaper form of deferral: an open card is read by every sweep, a closed one costs nothing and stays searchable.

**Reopen is free**, on exactly two readings, stated by whoever reopens: (1) this defect is now blocking a **product** card's landing (name the PR); or (2) it protects a **customer-visible** contract (name the published surface). ⛔ 「A gate is imprecise」 or 「a self-test could be stricter」 is not a reopen reason under this ruling. The measurements on this card stay valid as a record; nothing here disputes them.
